description: SYNTHETIC question set for claim_aware_rag_test_document.pdf (itself synthetic). Labels were written by the project author (single annotator) from the document text. 'relevant' lists substrings identifying gold evidence sentences. 'expected' is one of: answer, abstain, correct_premise, yes. Small (n=27) and not representative of real-world questions; use only as a regression/sanity benchmark.
